b2-jogvedelem-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Ombudsman
b2-jogvedelem-01.scenario: At a citizens' advice centre in Budapest, the adviser, Mária, asks what the Commissioner for Fundamental Rights does.
b2-jogvedelem-01.prompt: Tell Mária what the commissioner reports about and to whom, and what he or she cannot do.
cues: Say what the commissioner reports about, and to whom
Say that he or she cannot impose a fine
b2-jogvedelem-01.target: Az ombudsman évente beszámol az emberi jogi helyzetről az Országgyűlésnek. Ajánlást tesz, de bírságot nem szabhat ki.
b2-jogvedelem-01.english: Every year the ombudsman reports to the National Assembly on the human rights situation. He or she makes recommendations but cannot impose a fine.
b2-jogvedelem-01.canDo: I can describe what the Commissioner for Fundamental Rights (Alapvető Jogok Biztosa) does and how a citizen can complain to the office.

b2-jogvedelem-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Against a Decision
b2-jogvedelem-02.scenario: At a free legal advice hour, the lawyer, Dr Tamás Kiss, asks what you know about appeals.
b2-jogvedelem-02.prompt: Tell Dr Kiss what a client can do against a first-instance decision, and what the authority must do after a court ruling.
cues: Say what the client can do against the decision
Say what the authority must do after the ruling
b2-jogvedelem-02.target: Az ügyfél fellebbezhet a határozat ellen. A hatóság köteles eleget tenni a bíróság ítéletének.
b2-jogvedelem-02.english: The client can appeal against the decision. The authority is obliged to comply with the court's ruling.
b2-jogvedelem-02.canDo: I can say how a citizen can appeal against an administrative decision and go to court.

b2-jogvedelem-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Public Data
b2-jogvedelem-03.scenario: At a workshop in a Budapest library, the journalist, Eszter, asks how she can get a public contract.
b2-jogvedelem-03.prompt: Tell Eszter who can access public-interest data, and what she can do if the ministry refuses.
cues: Say who can access the data
Say what she can do if the ministry refuses
b2-jogvedelem-03.target: Bárki hozzáférhet a közérdekű adatokhoz, indoklás nélkül. Ha a minisztérium megtagadja, a NAIH-hoz fordulhat, vagy pert indíthat.
b2-jogvedelem-03.english: Anyone can access public-interest data, without giving a reason. If the ministry refuses, she can turn to the NAIH or start a lawsuit.
b2-jogvedelem-03.canDo: I can explain how anyone can ask a public body for public-interest data (közérdekű adatigénylés).

b2-jogvedelem-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The One Per Cent
b2-jogvedelem-04.scenario: At a volunteer fair in Pécs, a young volunteer, Dávid, asks how the 1% designation works.
b2-jogvedelem-04.prompt: Tell Dávid what a taxpayer can do with one per cent of their income tax, and what the organisation must do with the money.
cues: Say what the taxpayer can do
Say what the organisation must do with the money
b2-jogvedelem-04.target: Az adófizető felajánlhatja az adója egy százalékát egy civil szervezetnek. A szervezet köteles elszámolni a kapott forrásokkal.
b2-jogvedelem-04.english: The taxpayer can designate one per cent of his or her tax to a civil organisation. The organisation must account for the funds it has received.
b2-jogvedelem-04.canDo: I can name the legal forms of Hungarian civil organisations: associations (egyesületek) and foundations (alapítványok).

b2-jogvedelem-05.title: Communicative Challenge: An Appeal Letter
b2-jogvedelem-05.scenario: At the customer service desk of the Government Office, the clerk, Ilona, helps you write an appeal.
b2-jogvedelem-05.prompt: Tell Ilona how you start the letter, with a reference to the earlier decision, and ask the office politely to review it.
b2-jogvedelem-05.target: Hivatkozással a fent megjelölt határozatra benyújtom a fellebbezésemet. Tisztelettel kérem a Hivatalt, hogy vizsgálja felül a döntést.
b2-jogvedelem-05.english: With reference to the decision named above, I submit my appeal. I respectfully ask the Office to review the decision.
b2-jogvedelem-05.canDo: I can say what a formal submission to an authority contains.

b2-jogvedelem-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Defending Your Rights
b2-jogvedelem-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a civic-rights course, the teacher, Ágnes, asks you to name ways a citizen can defend his or her rights.
b2-jogvedelem-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ágnes what a citizen can do: go to the ombudsman, appeal against a decision, or ask for public data.
b2-jogvedelem-consolidation.target: A polgár panaszt nyújthat be az ombudsmanhoz. Fellebbezhet a határozat ellen, vagy közérdekű adatot igényelhet.
b2-jogvedelem-consolidation.english: A citizen can file a complaint with the ombudsman. He or she can appeal against the decision or request public-interest data.
b2-jogvedelem-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up in a few sentences how the ombudsman, the courts and civil organisations protect citizens' rights.
